requirements.title: Conversation, models, and reasoning
dependencies: Approved model providers and deployment aliases
Durable chat and Temporary Chat privacy boundaries
requirements.acceptanceTest: Exercise streaming, stop, retry, regenerate, edit, branch, persistence, explicit model selection, fallbacks, and private Temporary Chat behavior against the exact deployed candidate.
requirements.boundary: The current bounded chat and mode source does not establish Astra-class availability, live provider quality, or production persistence.

requirements.title: Search, browsing, and research
dependencies: Bounded browser runtime and confirmation policy
requirements.acceptanceTest: Run current-source web research and an approved signed-in browser task with citations, steering, confirmations, cancellation, durable recovery, and audit evidence.
requirements.boundary: Search and bounded research exist, but safe signed-in computer use and complete cross-source production acceptance remain unfinished.

requirements.title: Multimodal input and understanding
dependencies: Provider support for each media type
Camera, microphone, and screen permission UX
requirements.acceptanceTest: Verify supported documents, images, audio, video, camera, microphone, and screen inputs across extraction, reasoning, provenance, privacy, and failure states on physical devices.
requirements.boundary: Text, image, and document foundations exist; audio, video, camera, microphone, and screen-input completion is not established.

requirements.title: Image creation and editing
dependencies: Approved image providers and capability discovery
requirements.acceptanceTest: Generate, edit, mask, vary, save, share, and download images through fast and precision routes while proving quality selection, safety, provenance, quotas, retries, and settlement.
requirements.boundary: Current image generation/editing source does not prove Flare-class or Sunburst-class routing, live quality tiers, or production settlement.

requirements.title: Live voice and audio
requirements.acceptanceTest: Complete a full-duplex conversation with barge-in, captions, device selection, privacy controls, agent delegation, reconnect, and bounded cost on supported devices.
requirements.boundary: Voice is required by the September 11 goal but remains unavailable; no prior exclusion may be treated as current scope.

requirements.title: Files, data analysis, and generated artifacts
requirements.sourceSection: Files, data analysis, and generated artifacts
requirements.acceptanceTest: Round-trip representative documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, code, notebooks, charts, and templates through upload, analysis, editing, versioning, export, sharing, and deletion.
requirements.boundary: Bounded file, sandbox, editor, and export source exists; the complete template-driven artifact and real-file matrix is unfinished.

requirements.title: Projects, memory, personalization, and learning
requirements.acceptanceTest: Verify project-scoped files, instructions, memory, sharing, retention, export/deletion, user memory controls, personalization, and Study progress across two accounts.
requirements.boundary: Useful foundations exist, but Project retention, live two-account isolation, and final learning/personalization acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Library and knowledge organization
requirements.acceptanceTest: Exercise search, filters, metadata, folders, preview, rename, move, versions, restore, sharing, quotas, retention, export, and deletion without orphaning or cross-tenant access.
requirements.boundary: Library source is substantial; matching production schema/storage, restore/sharing depth, and live isolation remain unverified.

requirements.title: Tasks and event-driven automation
requirements.acceptanceTest: Run one-time, recurring, conditional, event-triggered, copied, and signed-in browser tasks through timezone changes, retries, pause/resume, limits, notifications, and audit history.
requirements.boundary: CRUD, recurrence, event-ingress, and worker contracts exist; shareable customization, live callbacks, free/paid limits, and browser-task acceptance remain incomplete.

requirements.title: Durable agents and non-blocking work
dependencies: Durable run storage and worker identity
requirements.acceptanceTest: Start, steer, side-chat with, disconnect from, resume, cancel, and recover a multi-agent task across devices while enforcing context, authority, loop, concurrency, time, and cost bounds.
requirements.boundary: Durable Work and bounded specialist runs exist; side-chat, cross-task references, complete steering, and portable hosted/self-hosted runtime acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Apps, connectors, tools, MCP, and WebMCP
requirements.sourceSection: Apps, connectors, tools, MCP, and WebMCP
requirements.acceptanceTest: Connect multiple accounts, discover approved tools, read and perform a confirmed write, revoke access, and prove provider-neutral MCP/WebMCP isolation, rate limits, and audit behavior.
requirements.boundary: Google/GitHub and MCP foundations plus versioned workflow skills exist; WebMCP and complete provider/account live acceptance do not.

requirements.title: Custom Kovas, reusable skills, and discovery
requirements.sourceSection: Custom Kovas, reusable skills, and discovery
requirements.acceptanceTest: Create, test, version, publish, share, install, update, fork, archive, report, and delete a Kova and a reusable skill while proving permissions and tenant isolation.
requirements.boundary: Custom Kova and workflow-skill foundations exist; full discovery/store governance, analytics, organization distribution, and production canaries remain.

requirements.title: Sharing and collaboration
requirements.acceptanceTest: Share and revoke chats, Projects, artifacts, files, agents, and tasks between two accounts; verify role changes, expiration, copy/fork, comments, mentions, conflicts, ownership transfer, and history.
requirements.boundary: Several sharing and collaboration paths exist; complete object coverage and live two-account/realtime behavior remain unfinished.

requirements.title: Notifications and cross-device experience
dependencies: Native clients where web/PWA cannot satisfy requirements
requirements.acceptanceTest: Deliver and deep-link in-app, email, push, and supported system notifications across reconnect, offline, device change, safe areas, accessibility, and localization.
requirements.boundary: In-app and web-push foundations exist; email/system delivery, physical devices, native surfaces, and complete cross-device acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Identity, safety, privacy, and user control
requirements.sourceSection: Identity, safety, privacy, and user control
requirements.acceptanceTest: Verify signup, OAuth, MFA, recovery, sessions/devices, linking, abuse controls, tenant isolation, family/admin policy, privacy choices, export, deletion, retention, and incident paths.
requirements.boundary: Substantial source controls exist; approved policy, live identity/delivery, cross-system erasure, recovery, and production evidence remain.

requirements.title: Plans, entitlements, billing, and premium compute
requirements.sourceSection: Plans, entitlements, billing, and premium compute
dependencies: Approved commercial policy and Stripe configuration
One server-owned entitlement and compute ledger
Provider usage reconciliation and kill switches
requirements.acceptanceTest: Exercise checkout, portal, upgrade/downgrade, cancellation, payment failure, idempotent webhooks, and bounded reservations/settlement across every billable category and retry edge.
requirements.boundary: Consumer/developer billing foundations exist; unified premium accounting across all categories and live commercial canaries are not established.

requirements.title: Developer platform
dependencies: Usage, billing, webhook, and support operations
requirements.acceptanceTest: Use documented APIs/SDKs for responses, streaming, files, images, audio, tools, agents, tasks, and webhooks with rotation, quotas, logs, versioning, revocation, and isolation.
requirements.boundary: Responses, files, SDK, MCP, and billing source exists; audio/realtime, agent/task breadth, public activation, support, and production canaries remain.

requirements.title: Organization and enterprise operation
dependencies: Verified domains, SSO/SAML, and SCIM identity
Administrative audit, analytics, and spending controls
requirements.acceptanceTest: Provision and offboard an organization across domain verification, SSO, SCIM, roles, groups, service accounts, retention, connector/model/tool policy, audit, export, deletion, and support.
requirements.boundary: Organization, SSO adapter, and SCIM source exists; live IdP/domain/legal, retention execution, analytics, residency, and production tenant evidence remain.

requirements.title: Premium-compute safety contract
dependencies: Global kill switches and anomaly alerts
requirements.acceptanceTest: Prove per-request, user, period, plan, organization, and global bounds across duplicates, retries, continuations, delegates, tools, disconnects, cancellations, partial failures, unknown usage, and rollover.
requirements.boundary: Several bounded ledgers exist; one coherent cross-category premium-compute system is not yet proven.

requirements.title: Interface and product-quality contract
dependencies: Cohesive design system and truthful capability metadata
Desktop, mobile, native, accessibility, localization, motion, and performance evidence
requirements.acceptanceTest: Pass the agreed viewport, theme, touch, keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, long-content, safe-area, no-overflow, lifecycle-state, and performance matrices, then obtain owner acceptance.
requirements.boundary: Hosted browser gates verify bounded current journeys, not the complete interface contract; UI remains the separate owner-declared 1% assessment.

requirements.title: Architecture, independence, and release gates
dependencies: Supabase, Cloudflare, Azure, Microsoft/Entra, Stripe, and GitHub release evidence
Backups, monitoring, rollback, and exact deployed provenance
requirements.acceptanceTest: Pass every exact-commit source/review/CI gate, then with separate approval prove migrations, deployed SHA/image, production journeys, provider/billing safety, origin protection, monitoring, backups, recovery, and rollback.
requirements.boundary: Source and hosted evidence do not establish staging or production; no merge, migration, deployment, purchase, or live configuration change is authorized here.
